verdict: Strong 28-day ROAS, but purchase volume dropped sharply this past week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $7,000.75 on $1,479.52 in spend — a 4.73x return — which is a healthy result for the full window. However, purchase volume thinned noticeably in the most recent 7 days, down 30.77% from the prior 7-day period, and the last 3 days of the window recorded just 1 purchase. The findings point clearly to a spend pullback — daily spend averaged $52.04 in recent days versus higher levels prior — which compressed ad delivery and reduced purchase opportunity; the creative itself is not the issue. Ad spend levels are being stabilized to restore delivery and recover purchase volume heading into next week. Conversion tracking is also being completed so that revenue attribution can be fully confirmed going forward.
